translation:
(Chuanxiong serves as its envoy; it is averse to the five stone fats (wushizhi), and fears Changpu (Acorus), Huanglian (Coptis), Shigao (gypsum), and Huanghuan.)

Original text of the Benjing: Xinyi (Magnolia flower), pungent in flavor, warm. It chiefly treats cold-heat of the five viscera and body, wind headache, and facial ... .
